stance: Policy stance is hawkish-leaning. The Fed held at 3.75-4.00% on 2026-10-28 with a 10-2 vote, both dissenters favouring a hike. The ECB held at 2.50% on 2026-10-29; tone and vote unconfirmed. The BoE hiked 25bp to 4.0% on 2026-11-05, 8-1 (Mann for 50bp), guidance conditional on energy and second-round effects (vote unconfirmed by a second source). September euro-area HICP at 3.75% keeps a December ECB hike in play. Softer inflation or lower energy would ease the view; an ECB hike signal would harden it.
